# Hemenster

[Kandarin](kandarin.md) › Hemenster

The Fishing Contest town west of the Ranging Guild, from the river (x 2623) to the guild fence: Morris at its gate (2643, 3440), the contest spots west of the fence at x 2642 and Grandpa Jack (2650, 3452) (quests/quest_fishingcompo). The world map label sits at the guild door.
